Alberta residents aged 65 and older.
Holders of a Certificate of Indian Status under the Indian Act.

Exempt anglers must still follow the sportfishing rules.

All tidal anglers, including children.

Record retained chinook and halibut immediately, plus lingcod in the specified areas.

jurisdictions.name: Manitoba
jurisdictions.summary: Visitors aged 16 and older generally need a Manitoba angling licence. A licence's expiry date does not determine when a fishing season is open.

keyRules: Carry the licence on paper or an electronic device.
Follow the separate season dates for your water.

jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Prices use the government's 2026 fee table. The guide lists base amounts before GST; confirm the final total and youth conditions.

jurisdictions.name: New Brunswick
jurisdictions.summary: Visitors aged 16 and older generally need an angling licence. A salmon licence and a guide can be necessary even when a basic angling licence seems sufficient.
whoNeedsOne: Visiting anglers aged 16 and older.
Visitors targeting sea-run Atlantic salmon need the salmon licence category.
exemptions: Visitors under 16 need no licence for fish other than Atlantic salmon.
An unlicensed visitor under 16 can share an accompanying salmon licence holder's catch-and-release limit.

options.name: Non-resident general season, except sea-run Atlantic salmon
Non-resident general 7-day, except sea-run Atlantic salmon
Non-resident general 3-day, except sea-run Atlantic salmon

Short licences cover consecutive calendar days.
Check the guide requirement for the exact water and date.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Use the Fish and Wildlife Licensing System, an authorized vendor, or Service New Brunswick.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Prices exclude tax. Confirm the tidal-water boundary and applicable federal rules; no general saltwater exemption is asserted here.

jurisdictions.name: Newfoundland and Labrador

authority.name: Department of Forestry, Agriculture and Lands; Fisheries and Oceans Canada

jurisdictions.summary: Visitors need a trout licence in non-scheduled inland waters and a salmon licence in scheduled inland waters. A visitor who keeps trout in scheduled waters also needs a trout licence.
whoNeedsOne: Non-residents fishing for trout in non-scheduled inland waters.
Non-residents fishing in scheduled inland waters need a salmon licence.
exemptions: Provincial residents need no inland trout licence.
No salmon or trout licence is required in coastal waters.

extras.name: Vendor processing fee

jurisdictions.saltwater: The coastal salmon and trout fishery does not require these licences. Coastal seasons and limits still apply.
jurisdictions.guidedTrips: On Newfoundland and south of 52°N in Labrador, visitors need a guide or eligible direct relative on scheduled rivers or beyond 800 metres from a provincial highway. Northern Labrador has additional outfitter requirements.

Check current river closures.
A family licence shares one catch limit.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Buy from commercial licence vendors throughout the province.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm northern Labrador outfitter exceptions and family-licence eligibility for your party.

jurisdictions.name: Northwest Territories

whoNeedsOne: Visiting anglers who do not meet an age or other exemption.
exemptions: Canadian residents under 16 or aged 65 and older qualify for the stated age exemptions.
Foreign children under 16 can fish with a valid licence holder; confirm special-area conditions.

extras.name: Great Bear Lake authorization

extras.name: Inuvialuit Settlement Region authorization
extras.when: Required in addition to the standard licence, regardless of age or residency.

extras.name: National park permit
extras.when: An NWT licence is not valid in a national park.

keyRules: Carry the licence.
Use barbless hooks.
Stay within daily and possession limits.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Buy through NWT eServices or a participating licence outlet.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Listed fees include GST. Confirm the youth boundary with the department: its page uses inconsistent wording around age 16. Saltwater coverage and guide-client exemptions were not confirmed.

jurisdictions.name: Nova Scotia
jurisdictions.summary: Anglers aged 16 and older need a general licence for freshwater species other than salmon. Atlantic salmon requires a separate licence.
whoNeedsOne: Resident and visiting freshwater anglers aged 16 and older.
exemptions: Children aged 15 and younger need no general licence.
Anglers aged 16 or 17 receive a free general licence.

extras.name: Salmon licence
extras.when: Required for Atlantic salmon; the general licence does not cover salmon.

jurisdictions.saltwater: No general fishing licence is required in tidal or salt water. Federal and provincial rules still apply.
keyRules: Carry a paper or phone copy of the licence.
Submit the general licence report card within seven days after the season ends, even with no catch.
The general licence does not authorize fishing in national parks.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Apply online through the official licence service or buy from a licence vendor.

sources.title: General fishing licence requirements and fees

jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm the salmon fee and final payment total. No guide-client exemption was confirmed.

jurisdictions.name: Nunavut
jurisdictions.summary: Visitors generally need a Nunavut sport fishing licence. A territorial licence does not cover national parks.
whoNeedsOne: Visitors who do not meet an exemption.
exemptions: Beneficiaries of the Nunavut Agreement.
Canadian residents under 16.
Foreign children under 16 when accompanied by a sport fishing licence holder.
Canadian residents over 65 need a licence but pay no licence fee.

extras.name: National park permit
extras.when: Required where national park fishing is permitted.

keyRules: Carry the licence.
Do not use live fish as bait.
Do not sell sport-caught fish.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Buy from the Department of Environment, most fishing lodges, or participating retail stores.

Canadian visitors aged 18 to 64, unless exempt.
exemptions: Foreign visitors under 18 can share an accompanying licence holder's catch limit.
Canadian residents under 18 or aged 65 and older qualify for the age exemption with the required identification.

extras.name: Outdoors Card
extras.when: Required with multi-day and annual licences unless exempt.

keyRules: Carry the licence summary.
Conservation licences have lower catch limits.
A one-day licence ends at midnight.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Use the Fish and Wildlife Licensing Service, a licence issuer, or a participating ServiceOntario office.

jurisdictions.name: Prince Edward Island

whoNeedsOne: Resident and visiting anglers aged 16 and older.

Active Canadian Forces members and veterans receive a courtesy licence with no conservation charge.

whoNeedsOne: Non-residents fishing for species covered by Quebec's sport fishing rules.

extras.name: Atlantic salmon licence
extras.when: The general licence excludes Atlantic salmon.

Use the correct residency category.
Annual licences end on March 31.

Quebec licence rules and non-resident outfitter requirement

jurisdictions.name: Saskatchewan

whoNeedsOne: Canadian and foreign visitors aged 16 and older, unless exempt.
exemptions: Children under 16.
Saskatchewan residents aged 65 and older.
Eligible Canadian Armed Forces veterans receive free licences.

extras.when: Required in national parks.

Do not share or transfer a licence.
All children need their own salmon catch card to fish for salmon.

Annual permit: Banff, Jasper, Yoho and Kootenay

Do not sell fish caught on the flats.

jurisdictions.name: Honduras

authority.name: SAG, Directorate General of Fisheries and Aquaculture (DIGEPESCA)

jurisdictions.summary: DIGEPESCA lists a sport fisher permit and a separate permit category for tourism businesses. Confirm the visitor permit before your trip; a tourism operator's permit does not establish a guest exemption.
whoNeedsOne: Sport fishers fall within DIGEPESCA's published permit categories.
keyRules: Submit the applicable identity and photograph documents.
Pay the government fee through the prescribed TGR process.
Release billfish caught during sport or tourism fishing.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Apply at a DIGEPESCA regional office or the central Control and Inspection Department.

jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm the current fee, duration, foreign-passport procedure, shore rules and marine park permissions. The quoted fee comes from the 2023 official schedule.

jurisdictions.name: Jamaica
jurisdictions.summary: Jamaica requires fishers and their vessels to register, including recreational fishers. Do not assume a charter booking removes the licence requirement; confirm your visitor documents with the authority.
whoNeedsOne: Recreational fishers and their vessels fall within the authority's licensing system.
keyRules: Obtain the required licence before you fish or attempt to fish.
Provide current government identification and a passport-size photograph for the fisher application.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Apply through the National Fisheries Authority's IrieFins service or a fisheries office.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm tourist eligibility, charter-client coverage, licence categories, fees, duration, shore rules and exemptions.

jurisdictions.name: Nicaragua

authority.name: Nicaraguan Institute of Fisheries and Aquaculture (INPESCA)

jurisdictions.summary: Nicaraguan and foreign sport fishers need an INPESCA permit. The requirement includes shore, boat and underwater fishing.
whoNeedsOne: National and foreign individuals or organizations that conduct sport fishing.
jurisdictions.saltwater: The permit requirement covers shore and boat fishing; no general sea-shore exemption appears in the cited law.
keyRules: Carry the personal, non-transferable permit.
Follow the catch-and-release principle and the applicable season, gear and catch rules.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Apply to INPESCA with the fishing area, species, gear, dates and vessel details. The form lists daily, weekly and season categories.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm fees, short-term visitor documents, guide-client coverage and the separate Río San Juan conditions with INPESCA.

jurisdictions.name: Panama
jurisdictions.summary: Panama's fisheries law requires an ARAP licence for sport fishing. A new personal-card system starts on December 10, 2026, after this record's check date.
whoNeedsOne: Sport fishers fall under the licence requirement in article 66 of Law 204 of 2021.
jurisdictions.saltwater: The statutory requirement covers inland waters and marine waters under Panamanian jurisdiction.
jurisdictions.guidedTrips: Decree 9 provides a client exemption for authorized tourism fishing services from December 10, 2026. Confirm the present arrangement with ARAP.
keyRules: Carry the applicable ARAP authorization.
Do not apply the new December 2026 card rules to an earlier trip.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Ask ARAP for the permit process that applies on your trip date.

sources.title: Official Gazette, Decree 9 of June 10, 2026, including commencement and Law 204 reference

jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm the current permit, fee and client coverage. Decree 9 starts six months after June 10 publication; its new fees are not current on November 11.

jurisdictions.name: Peru

authority.name: Ministry of Production (PRODUCE) and regional fisheries authorities

jurisdictions.summary: Individuals who fish for sport without a boat qualify for a national permit exemption. Do not assume this exemption covers a fishing boat or protected-area access.
exemptions: Individuals who fish for sport without a vessel, under article 29 of Supreme Decree 012-2001-PE.
jurisdictions.saltwater: The general fisheries regulation covers sea and inland resources. The stated sport-fishing exemption depends on fishing without a vessel.
keyRules: Keep the activity non-commercial.
Check the applicable species, season and protected-water restrictions.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: No national permit purchase applies to the stated shore exemption. Ask PRODUCE or the regional fisheries office about a boat trip.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm boat permits, foreign visitor coverage, regional inland rules and protected-area access. No visitor boat-permit fee or purchase portal was confirmed.

jurisdictions.name: Saint Lucia
jurisdictions.summary: The published recreational boat-fishing licence is only for Saint Lucia's citizens or residents. A visiting tourist must confirm a separate arrangement with the Fisheries Department.
whoNeedsOne: Eligible citizens or residents use the published recreational licence to fish from a vessel.

options.name: Citizen or resident recreational boat licence

keyRules: The published application is restricted to citizens or residents.
A fishing vessel requires the applicable vessel licence.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Eligible applicants submit the form to the Fisheries Department. The stated processing time is three to five business days.

sources.title: Recreational fishing licence and EC$50 fee

jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm the foreign tourist route, shore rules, water coverage, charter-client coverage and licence duration. The fee shown is not a verified tourist price.

jurisdictions.name: Suriname

authority.name: Ministry of Agriculture, Animal Husbandry and Fisheries, Directorate of Fisheries

jurisdictions.summary: Suriname publishes a sport-fishing permit application. The form does not establish whether each visiting angler needs a separate permit or a guide's permit covers clients.
keyRules: The application asks for the fishing area and equipment.
The application asks for the applicant's identity and the vessel's details.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Contact the Directorate of Fisheries at Cornelis Jongbawstraat 50, Paramaribo, or +597 476741 / 472233 for the application.

sources.title: Official sport fishing permit application page

jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm personal versus vessel coverage, foreign visitor eligibility, inland and marine rules, duration and fee. The form's stamp charge is not a verified licence price.

jurisdictions.name: Uruguay
jurisdictions.summary: Uruguay generally allows sport fishing without a permit. Specific areas, species, dates or methods can require one, so check the exact water before your trip.
whoNeedsOne: Anglers in an activity or area subject to a specific permit rule.
exemptions: The general sport-fishing rule in article 44 allows fishing freely, subject to regulated exceptions.
keyRules: Do not sell a recreational catch.
Do not export a recreational catch; the law limits export authorization to research agreements.
Do not buy or transfer another person's fishing permit.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: There is no general sport-fishing permit purchase under article 44. Contact DINARA for any specific authorization.

sources.title: DINARA notice on permits and recreational catch, July 2026

jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Ask DINARA about the Uruguay River and CARU requirements, protected waters, charter permissions and any local fees.
